notes: Fixes the Initial Balance not drawing on overnight futures sessions, plus several session-boundary and label fixes.
changelog: Fixed the IB not drawing on overnight sessions such as CME futures when anchored to the calendar day without a fixed start time
Fixed IBs that end at or after midnight never completing
Labels now sit at the right end of the lines on the live session instead of where the IB ended
The IB now completes and draws on its last bar instead of one bar later
With Extend Lines To Session End off, lines stop at the session end and charts load faster
The update notice can now appear as soon as the chart goes live
